[[Trading Blows (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:Trading blows map.jpg|160px]] }} Investigate the reports of [[Ministry of Purity]] and [[Jade Brotherhood]] forces in [[Kurzick]] territory. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== *Search for signs of suspicious activity. *Protect the [[Kurzick Diplomat]]s. *See [[Guardsman Qao Lin]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *2,500 [[Experience]] *1,000 [[Gold]] *1,000 [[Kurzick faction|Kurzick Faction]] *[[Imperial Guard Requisition Order]] *[[Imperial Commendation]] ===Environmental changes=== * While this quest is active, neither [[Darkroot Entrop]], [[Milefaun Mindflayer]], nor [[Foalcrest Darkwish]], and their respective groups, spawn. ==Walkthrough== [[File:Trading_Blows_incoming_enemy_directions.jpg|thumb|Enemies flank from three directions]] Start from [[Amatz Basin (outpost)|Amatz Basin]], follow the quest markers through [[Mourning Veil Falls]], and protect the Kurzick Diplomats. They are high level [[healer]]s, but you will get attacked by enemies that [[spawn]] from three different directions, be sure not to leave them unprotected against attacks from behind. Alternatively you can fight at the slope directly across from where the diplomats were standing. The diplomats should be able to keep themselves alive as long as you distract the incoming enemies enough. Keep your healers just in range so that they can still [[heal]] the diplomats. This will allow your party to avoid most of the [[area of effect]] (AoE) damage, making the fight much easier. If having difficulty with the waves of foes, use a [[minion master]] [[hero]] and [[Hero flag|flag]] it into the shallow stream to the south of the Diplomats (and slightly east) - they will follow the [[minion]]s to heal and be out of range of the majority of spawns. Note that the Jade Brotherhood and Ministry of Purity ''are'' hostile towards each other; if you can get the Kurzicks out of the way, the enemies will thin themselves. === Skill recommendations === * [[Blood is Power]] and/or minions for exploiting the Kurzick Diplomats' [[AI]]. * AoE damage and control skills, especially [[Pain of Disenchantment]], [[Ineptitude]] and/or [[Panic]]. * AoE support skills (so that your [[List of skills which affects allies|allies benefit]]), especially [[Recuperation]], [[Shelter]] and/or [[Union]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]]s ([[Kurzick]]s) *{{mo}} 26 Once all enemies have been slain: :'''Kurzick Diplomat:''' ''"Thank you, friend. We are in your debt for what you have done this day. Still, I fear that this is only a single day."'' :'''Kurzick Diplomat:''' ''"More and more, people come into our lands, making demands of us. Can they not see why we wish to avoid their Empire? Perhaps insanity is only seen when looking in from the outside."'' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Guardsman Qao Lin :''"By the ancestors... The Jade Brotherhood is trying to turn the Kurzicks against the Ministry of Purity? I doubt they'll get involved now. They remain as detached as they can concerning matters of the Empire. But if the Jade Brotherhood had been able to make it look like the Ministry was actively targeting them, they might have gotten involved, for good or ill. For now, I'm just glad that there's one less faction that we need to keep our eyes on. Once again, we find ourselves in your debt."''
